outcome.description: After a bench trial the Fairfax County Circuit Court entered judgment for 7205 Telegraph on all four counts, awarding $481,434.84 in lost-rent contract damages, a further $6,296.70 for over-assessments, release of the association's liens, and $324,977.60 in attorney's fees and costs. A Court of Appeals panel affirmed on April 25, 2023; rehearing en banc was granted, and on December 19, 2023 the court lifted the stay and left the judgment affirmed.
outcome.finalNote: Affirmed, including after rehearing en banc.

source.caseName: Telegraph Square II, a Condominium Unit Owners Association v. 7205 Telegraph Square, LLC
source.court: Court of Appeals of Virginia (panel opinion Apr. 25, 2023; rehearing en banc granted June 6, 2023; Dec. 19, 2023 published order lifting stay, judgment remains affirmed)

source.excerptNote: Verbatim sentences from the April 25, 2023 panel opinion's BACKGROUND sections A (Condominium Instruments) and B (Condominium Parking), plus the opening sentence identifying 7205 Telegraph's ownership; several bylaw/declaration block quotes, the 2017 replacement-lease details, and the 2019 acceleration letters were omitted for length. Removed: the appellate summary of assignments of error, section C (Trial Court Rulings) including the $481,434.84 damages award, the over-assessment findings, the attorney-fee award, and all analysis.
